purpose: People who click 'join the newsletter feed' get Mautic onboarding (welcome, weekly recap); the Listmonk list stays the base list.

inputs.what: contacts, segments, campaigns (after the Connect release)

steps.do: New feed subscribers → Mautic contact + segment 'Community onboarding'
Keep the welcome and weekly-recap campaigns current (content from P5)

outputs: every feed subscriber in the onboarding segment within 24 h
done_when: no subscriber older than 24 h missing from the segment
